def generate(rng):
    # Sparse grids made from separated straight triominoes and 2x2 squares,
    # sometimes joined edge-to-edge into composite objects, all initially gray.
    h = rng.randint(5, 18); w = rng.randint(5, 18)
    g = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]

                 [(r+i,c+j) for i in range(2) for j in range(2)])
        # only place if no collision, preserving recognizable objects
